topic: Keeping API Keys From the Model
hook: Is your API key sitting in the system prompt, one injection away from leaking?
bullets: A key in the system prompt shows up in every trace
Claude gets only the question and tool definitions
The tool handler pulls the key from Key Vault at run time
The clerk's scoped token makes the CRM return billing data only
Claude writes the answer without ever seeing the key
cta: Watch the flow, then go deeper in the full course:
shows: This short animation shows API keys kept out of the prompt so the model never sees them.
